title: Greetings
label: ch:greetings
canDo: I can greet someone in Malayalam, read and write namaskāram from sound, recognize the reply, and choose an appropriate response.

payoff.summary: Greet and respond, read namaskāram aloud, then write it from dictation and check the three practised groups.
payoff.note: The greeting is heard before script; its eight shapes arrive in groups of two or three, and a small familiar unit reaches dictation before the whole word does.
